Package game.crops

Class Strawberry

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.plants.Plant
game.crops.Crop
game.crops.Strawberry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Harvestable, Producing, Regressible, FreelyWaterable, Waterable
public class Strawberry extends Crop implements Waterable, Producing
A strawberry crop. It can be watered, which scatters strawberries onto adjacent tiles, and it can be harvested at any time for strawberries, though harvesting risks destroying the plant.

Every 5 turns it drops a strawberry on an adjacent tile by itself, which may be rotten. When it is regressed it goes back to being a StrawberrySprout.
